summary: E-IZICUT full-stack tested. Backend: 20 pytest tests executed, 18 passed. 2 'failures' were incorrect test assumptions on my side (see notes) — backend is 100% functional. All required endpoints work: /years returns [2026,2025]; /satfung?tahun=2025 returns 34 satfung with counts; /stats?tahun=2025 returns total_personil=711, total_satfung=34, total_pengajuan=224, recent[]; search by 'MANAF' finds MANAF ANGGILULI (1 result) with leave_count; detail returns full record with leaves; login with admin/Mimika2026! works; wrong password → 401; admin write endpoints correctly reject anonymous requests (401) and accept Bearer tokens; POST/PATCH/DELETE personnel and leaves flow (Create → GET → Update → GET → Delete → 404) verified; /template returns valid xlsx spreadsheet. 2026 has 0 leaves by design (per Excel source). Frontend: Dashboard renders with E-IZICUT hero, search bar, year chips (2025/2026), satfung chips, bento stats and recent activity. Switching year 2026→2025 correctly updates total_personil from 721 to 711 and refreshes satfung/stats. Search 'MANAF' filters to 1 personnel-row and tapping opens profile with identity + grouped leave sections. Admin login navigates to /admin panel showing upload-excel-button, download-template-button, add-personnel-button; add-personnel-sheet opens correctly. As admin, personnel profile shows edit-person-button (pencil), add-leave-fab (Tambah Izin/Cuti) and per-section add buttons. Only console warnings observed: React Native web "shadow*" style props deprecated (use boxShadow) — minor, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning across screens: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — appears in RN Web build. Non-blocking but should migrate style props (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) to boxShadow (or platform-guard) for RN Web parity.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow (or Platform.select) to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
NO backend fixes needed. NO functional frontend fixes needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via clean() helper — good.
All admin write endpoints correctly gated by require_admin dependency.
Env vars used properly on both sides; no hardcoded URLs.
leave-types endpoint returns 7 keys (IZIN, EMERGENCY, CUTI_TAHUNAN, CUTI_BEROBAT, CUTI_IBADAH_UMROH, CUTI_IBADAH_HAJI, CUTI_IBADAH_LAINNYA) — matches PRD ('Umroh/Haji/Lainnya' split).
Test data cleanup verified: TEST_QA_USER was soft-deleted at end of CRUD flow.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data created. Temporary TEST_QA_USER personnel was created and soft-deleted during CRUD flow tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest assertion errors were due to my incorrect expectations — NOT backend bugs: (1) test_stats_2025 asserted total_personil==711 but got 712 because the parallel CRUD worker had just inserted TEST_QA_USER; use serial run or exclude TEST_ prefix. (2) test_leave_types asserted len==5 but backend correctly returns 7 (Umroh/Haji/Lainnya are separate keys per PRD). Both should be updated in future runs — assert len==7 and use --dist=no or a separate DB namespace for stats snapshots.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. App matches the PRD and the review request expectations.
